abort.missing_account_identity: TRMNL did not say which account you signed in to. Sign in again and keep "Sign you in" selected.
abort.missing_scopes: Home Assistant needs to read and change your TRMNL devices. Sign in again and keep "Read your devices" and "Change your device settings" selected.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: You signed in to a different TRMNL account. Sign in to the original account.

oauth_discovery.description: Home Assistant found a TRMNL device on your network. Select **Submit** to sign in to your TRMNL account.

reauth_confirm.description: The TRMNL integration needs you to sign in to your account again.
reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]

action_error.message: An error occurred while communicating with TRMNL: {error}

authentication_error.message: Authentication failed. Please sign in to TRMNL again.

migration_connection_error.message: Could not reach TRMNL to move this entry from the API key to signing in. Home Assistant will try again.

migration_duplicate.message: This TRMNL account is already set up with a newer entry. Remove this entry.

migration_failed.message: TRMNL no longer accepts the API key this entry was set up with. Remove the TRMNL integration and add it again to sign in.

update_error.message: An error occurred while communicating with TRMNL: {error}

abort.content_not_granted: Your TRMNL sign in does not let Home Assistant change plugin settings. Home Assistant has started a new sign in: finish it from the TRMNL integration with "Change your markup, plugin settings, playlists and mashups" selected, then pick the entities again.

data_description.home_entities: The first time, Home Assistant creates a Home Assistant plugin on your TRMNL account. Add it to a playlist.

init.description: Home Assistant sends the entities you pick to TRMNL when it starts and at most once a minute after they change. Nothing is sent until you pick at least one.
init.title: Show your home on TRMNL
